name: Pre-approved Personal Loan
rationale_template: Strong score, rising income and clean repayment support a pre-approved personal loan.

name: Credit Card Limit Increase / Upgrade
rationale_template: Low utilisation, high spends and an excellent score qualify a card limit increase / premium upgrade.

name: Home Loan Top-up
rationale_template: An on-time home loan with healthy LTV supports a renovation/consolidation top-up.

name: Wealth / SIP + FD
rationale_template: Rising income and idle savings make a SIP step-up + laddered FD a natural next step.

name: Insurance Top-up (Term / Health)
rationale_template: Cover should track income; a protection gap is a service-led cross-sell.

name: Card EMI Conversion / Balance Transfer
rationale_template: Converting a revolving balance to EMI cuts 42% APR and stabilises the account.

name: Personal Loan Restructuring
rationale_template: For SMA accounts, restructuring / step-down protects the relationship over new credit.
